title: buttonCOMP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Button COMP instances, covering the operator-specific click() method and inherited PanelCOMP / COMP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when a script needs to simulate a Button COMP panel click rather than driving the panel value indirectly.
Pass val when the button state should retain a specific value after the simulated click.
Use clickCount for double-click style interactions and left, middle, or right when the default left-button click is not the desired event.
Use force carefully: it can force the panel click even when the Button COMP is disabled.
There are no operator-specific members on buttonCOMP Class; use inherited PanelCOMP members for panel values, hierarchy, size, interaction state, and focus.
